richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in South Dum Dum

c: South Dum Dum is densely built, close to Kolkata airport, with ward parks and housing estates squeezed between busy roads. Space is the constraint here, so most of our work as an outdoor gym equipment supplier in South Dum Dum is about fitting useful machines into small corners. FunPlay Systems makes the Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,650 km away, and sends it to West Bengal by road.

Local clubs, residents' associations, schools and the municipality all look after small open spaces in this area. A compact open gym of three or four stations can sit along one edge of a park without taking away its football ground or walking path. We send a layout drawing with the clear space measured, and our team or a dealer in eastern India installs the machines.

items.q: How small a space can hold an outdoor gym?
items.a: A strip along one side of a park can take three or four stations. Combination machines fit more exercises into the same area. Send us the measurements and we will mark what fits.

items.q: Can local clubs order outdoor gym equipment directly?
items.a: Yes. Clubs, residents' associations, schools and civic bodies can all contact our sales team on +91 902 830 2266 or sales@funplaysystems.com.

items.q: How do the machines handle Kolkata's humidity?
items.a: The frames are galvanised and the seats and handles are roto-moulded, so they resist rust. Wipe them down after heavy rain and keep the base drained.
